description: This PHP source file defines the CompanyStructureService class, which provides various methods to manage organizational subunits, including retrieval, addition, deletion, and hierarchy navigation within a company's structure in an HRM system.

classes.name: CompanyStructureService
classes.description: Service class providing management operations for company organizational units (subunits), including CRUD operations, hierarchy management, and organization name setting.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureDao
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of CompanyStructureDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: setCompanyStructureDao
methods.description: Sets the CompanyStructureDao instance for dependency injection or mocking.

methods.name: getSubunitById
methods.description: Fetches a Subunit entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: saveSubunit
methods.description: Persists a Subunit entity to the database.

methods.name: addSubunit
methods.description: Adds a child subunit to a parent subunit, establishing hierarchy.

methods.name: deleteSubunit
methods.description: Deletes a subunit and its children from the database.

methods.name: setOrganizationName
methods.description: Sets or updates the organization name at the root of the subunit tree.

methods.name: getSubunitTree
methods.description: Retrieves the entire hierarchical tree of subunits, optionally limited by depth.

methods.name: getSubunitArray
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of subunits excluding the root node.

methods.name: getSubunitChainById
methods.description: Returns a list of IDs representing a chain of subunits from the specified subunit up to its ancestors.
